body: postgres 16 primary runs on ceph-node-07, replica on ceph-node-09
failover: promote replica with pg_ctl promote, update haproxy backend
redis 7 cluster, three shards, on nodes 11-13
rabbitmq quorum queues for intake events
osd drain requires backfillfull below 0.85 and nearfull below 0.80
five monitors, quorum needs three, mon-a is on the admin host
nvme wear alert on node 12 traced to smart attribute 202 misread
prefer boring proven technology over novel systems
oncall rotates monday 9am IST, handoff notes in /oncall/handoff
storage traffic isolated on vlan 40, public api on vlan 10
